stories.title: Suspect indicted for explosion at SRP substation in Mesa
stories.summary: The suspect is accused of causing an explosion at a substation that supplies power to a data center.

stories.title: Arizona Sen. Mark Kelly outlines 2027 priorities, including restoring SNAP benefits and banning congressional stock trading
stories.summary: Sen. Mark Kelly wants to restore food and health care benefits, ban congressional stock trading and strengthen workers' bargaining rights in 2027.

stories.title: Carjacking in Glendale leads to rollover crash in Peoria along Loop 101, police say
stories.summary: Peoria police are investigating a carjacking that led to a rollover crash on Loop 101 near Thunderbird Road, causing a temporary freeway closure.

stories.title: 'Boy Meets World' actress named Grand Marshal for 2027 Phoenix Children’s Fiesta Bowl Parade
stories.summary: Known for her role as Topanga in "Boy Meets World," a familiar Hollywood face with Valley roots will lead the 2026–27 Phoenix Children’s Fiesta Bowl Parade.

stories.title: Speeding driver in custody after crashing into wall, causing vehicle to burst into flames, Phoenix police say
stories.summary: According to the Arizona DPS, the crash only involved one car, and the intersection at 27th Avenue and I-10 was blocked.

stories.title: Busiest In-N-Out location is in Arizona, study finds
stories.summary: Three In-N-Out locations in Arizona made a list ranking the 25 busiest spots.

stories.title: Turkey Tuesday: How you can help Arizona families this holiday season
stories.summary: Together, we can help make sure more Arizona families have a reason to celebrate this Thanksgiving. Here's how to donate.

stories.title: Fall perfection across Arizona! Sunny, clear & dry
stories.summary: Look for some wind picking up across higher terrain, bringing in a few clouds for Wednesday.

stories.title: Man crushed by car he was working on in Phoenix
stories.summary: Phoenix Police said the man was pinned under the car after it shifted and fell on him. He was eventually taken to the hospital, where he later died.

stories.title: Family of Arizona firefighter killed in Colorado wildfire demands answers after federal investigation
stories.summary: Nick Hutcherson's parents say the investigation identifies failures but stops short of holding supervisors accountable for decisions that put the crew in danger.

stories.title: Elusive emu captured in Surprise, sightings of another emu reported
stories.summary: The emus reportedly escaped from a local farm after a gate was left open by a delivery driver.

stories.title: Train, semi-truck collision shuts down highway lanes in Pinal County
stories.summary: Maricopa police confirmed emergency crews responded to a crash involving a train and a semi-truck near Maricopa-Casa Grande Highway and White and Park Road.
